why: rcl hands the caller a heap `GoalStatusArray` to fill and publish (`rcl_action_get_goal_status_array` + `rcl_action_publish_status`). Ours is not a user-facing object at all: the arena keeps the status of every live goal and publishes the array itself on every transition (`ActionServerCore::publish_status_array`). No allocator to build the array with, and nothing for a caller to do with it. See `c:action_publish_status`.
